text:
Little man, little man,

set your canary free—it wants to fly…

I am the canary, little man;

let me leap away.

I was in your cage, little man,

little man who gives me a cage.

I call you little because you do not understand me,

and never will.

Nor do I understand you; but meanwhile,

open up the cage—I want to escape.

Little man, I loved you for half an hour;

do not ask me for more.

translation.title: Little Man
translation.editorial_note: The diminutive is kept as both belittlement and refrain, with the caged voice remaining sharp and unsentimental.
